decisions.reason: As a high-bandwidth infrastructure service that fits the firm's announced software-defined growth path and was prominently showcased, management is likely to justify continued commitment on the basis of strategic importance and sunk network investment.

The voice number ordering portal supports real-time provisioning and customer self-service in line with the firm's direction, so management would tend to persist with it and view any modest uptake as a temporary adoption issue.

Carrier pre-selection telephony looks like a legacy offer with weak visibility after launch and poor fit with the firm's move toward integrated cloud-oriented infrastructure, making it easier to stop despite prior investment.

Because direct voice network connection remains close to the firm's enterprise voice core and reuses existing network assets, management is likely to continue it and interpret its lower visibility as bundling or channel positioning rather than decisive failure.
